{{Top|leg}}
A '''fusion beam projector''' was a construction tool that superheated soil until it achieved a liquid state. They were installed aboard [[Excavator (vehicle)|excavators]] to create smooth sided tunnels<ref name="GSWU-Ex">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'' {{C|Excavator}}</ref> and was also used in the process known as [[fusion-forming]].<ref name="GSWU-FF">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'' {{C|Fusion forming}}</ref>
